compiled_state.description:
## Context
`.github/mutation-shards.toml` currently treats recursive `tests/**/conftest.py` as global support, so a change to any nested conftest selects all seven mutation shards. Across 97 recent completed Verify runs, seven proven candidate over-triggers consumed 322.6 runner-minutes (5.38 runner-hours) without increasing coverage. A top-level `tests/conftest.py` change genuinely affects all shards, but pytest only loads conftests in a test's directory and its ancestors—never sibling or descendant fixture trees. A runtime trace over every configured shard found the complete loaded ancestor union is exactly six files: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/unit/conftest.py`, `tests/interfaces/conftest.py`, `tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py`, `tests/scripts/conftest.py`, and `tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py`. The union of all shard tests still passes (374 passed, 1 skipped in 23.30s).

## Prior decisions and OSS research
No tracker ticket contains or rejects this exact proposal. `frowsy-beggarly-mammoth` rejected deleting a whole workflow from global support because that loses coverage; this change retains every dynamically loaded fixture dependency. `nostalgic-crumby-tick` requires support-input mapping, true mutation-infrastructure changes selecting all shards, isolated evidence, and no verdict cache; this satisfies those constraints. Three active OSS projects converge on dependency-accurate affected-test selection: pytest documents upward-only conftest discovery; Jest uses inverse dependency resolution for `--findRelatedTests`; Nx maps changed support inputs to owning/dependent projects while reserving true-global inputs for all targets. Consensus approval therefore applies only with a fail-closed drift contract.

## Plan
- Replace the recursive conftest global-support pattern with the six exact dynamically loaded ancestor paths, retaining top-level/global mutation infrastructure triggers.
- Add a deterministic contract that derives each shard test path's ancestor `conftest.py` candidates, intersects them with files present in the repository, and asserts the manifest's declared conftest support set equals that derived closure.
- Add selection cases proving an unrelated nested conftest no longer selects all shards and each declared ancestor conftest remains coverage-affecting.
- Prove fail-closed drift by defect-seeding a missing newly derived ancestor or stale recursive glob and observing the contract fail.
- Run focused mutation selector/contracts, the union of configured shard tests, lint, typecheck, and workflow/action policy gates.
- Land through Gerrit and measure avoided mutation runner occupancy on a later unrelated nested-conftest change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The manifest contains exactly the six conftest paths dynamically loaded by current shard tests, with no recursive conftest glob.
- [ ] A contract derives and compares the ancestor-conftest closure from configured shard test paths, failing on missing or stale entries.
- [ ] An unrelated nested conftest change does not select all mutation shards.
- [ ] Changes to each true ancestor conftest still select every mutation shard whose tests load it.
- [ ] Mutation source/test mappings and true mutation-infrastructure global triggers remain unchanged.
- [ ] All configured shard tests execute with unchanged pass/skip results.
- [ ] Focused tests, lint, typecheck, and applicable workflow guards pass.
- [ ] Gerrit LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 precede merge.

file_impact.reason: Replace recursive conftest support with the exact loaded ancestor set.
Expose or reuse deterministic shard-test ancestry logic for fail-closed validation if required.
Prove exact ancestor closure, unrelated nested-conftest exclusion, and fail-closed drift.
